infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CrowdSense uses your camera to take clear photos of road hazards, potholes, and civic infrastructure issues.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CrowdSense accesses your photo library so you can select and attach photos of civic issues to your report.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CrowdSense uses your location while using the app to accurately map civic issues and display nearby hazard alerts in your ward.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CrowdSense uses your microphone to transcribe voice reports on-device. Raw audio is processed locally and never leaves your device.
